title: The Chameleon Nature of LLMs: Quantifying Multi-Turn Stance Instability in Search-Enabled Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measured 'chameleon behavior' (stance instability) in LLMs across 12 controversial domains such as AI Ethics, Climate Change, and Vaccine Effectiveness.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the research.
